name: Sinus Tarsi Syndrome
definition: Lateral hindfoot pain arising from structures within the sinus tarsi, often after ankle sprain or with subtalar instability.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; MRI can assess synovitis, scar, ligament and subtalar pathology.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent symptoms may need injection or arthroscopic assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha/Pada mechanical phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Lateral hindfoot pain arising from structures within the sinus tarsi, often after ankle sprain or with subtalar instability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
